findings.what: An overturned appeal pays cash back for a bill the player never paid; the medical debt stays
findings.evidence: health.bill sets bill.paid=true before payFromCurrent; on failure it posts the full amount to the medical-debt account. Appeals are decided 60 days on, always after the 30-day due date, so bill.paid is always true by then. The refund posts `over` into the current account without reducing the debt account.
findings.suggestedFix: Track whether the bill was paid or went to debt (e.g. bill.unpaid). When it's in debt, credit the debt account by `over` (capped at its balance) instead of the current account

findings.what: Bills that went unpaid show 'Settled' on Papers
findings.evidence: paid=true is set for an unpaid bill too, and the UI prints b.paid ? 'Settled'
findings.suggestedFix: Set paid only on success; mark failures 'debt' and show that

findings.what: Therapy sessions count while asleep or in hospital
findings.evidence: The session handler checks location only. life.sleep warns 'You Slept Through 1 Commitment', yet the session is paid, counted, and can lift depression. Doctor appointments use present() and are missed.
findings.suggestedFix: Use health.ts:present(person, item.at, t.cityId); when absent, mark it missed and reschedule as for away

findings.what: Depression therapy is charged twice during a CBT course
findings.evidence: keepUp charges CHRONIC.therapyPerMonth (2) sessions a month for treated depression, whether or not person.therapy is running. The course charges each weekly session as well.
findings.suggestedFix: Skip keepUp's therapy cost while person.therapy is active, or let the course stand in for it

findings.what: health.treat toggle clears a lapse for free
findings.evidence: on:false then on:true sets lapsed=false with no payment, so keptUp is true again until the next health.month. That avoids the depression morale toll, diabetes condition toll and doubled asthma emergencies. Untreated through the 1st and re-treated after also skips the month's care.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep lapsed when re-treating, or charge the month's care on re-treat

findings.what: Workers' compensation can never happen in play

findings.what: Look After and Sleep are allowed from a hospital bed
